The '''''Mansk''-class escort frigate''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by the [[Tallaani Shipyards]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The ''Mansk''-class vessel, ''[[Knife's Edge]]'', was used by [[House Melantha]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="LD" />
